description: Calibration Management System - MetCal-like application for calibration laboratories with PyQt6, PyVISA, and MySQL

userStories.title: Database connection settings dialog
userStories.description: As an administrator, I need a settings dialog to configure MySQL connection so workstations can connect to the shared database.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Settings dialog accessible from File > Settings menu in app.py
Dialog has fields: Host, Port, Username, Password, Database Name
Test Connection button that calls DatabaseManager.connect() and shows success/failure
Save button stores settings to ~/.calsystem/config.json using pydantic-settings
Settings load automatically on app startup
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented by Ralph - Settings dialog with test connection

userStories.title: Database table creation on first run
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the database tables to be created automatically so the app works on fresh installations.
acceptanceCriteria: On successful database connection, call DatabaseManager.create_tables()
Tables created from models.py: standards, workstation_configs, workstation_standards, duts, procedures, test_sections, test_points, wiring_diagrams, command_banks, calibration_sessions, test_results
Status bar shows 'Database: Connected' on success
Error handling shows message box on connection failure
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - app.py calls db.create_tables() on successful connection in _load_settings_and_connect()

userStories.title: VISA instrument scanning
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to scan for connected GPIB/COM instruments so I can see what's available.
acceptanceCriteria: Scan button in WorkstationTab calls VISAManager.scan_and_identify()
Results populate detected_table with columns: Address, Manufacturer, Model, Serial, Status
Scan runs in QThread to keep UI responsive
Status shows 'Scanning...' during scan, 'Found X instruments' when done
Handles PyVISA not installed gracefully with error message
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - ScanWorker QThread calls VISAManager.scan_and_identify(), populates detected_table

userStories.title: Add standard dialog
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to add a detected instrument as a workstation standard so I can use it for calibrations.
acceptanceCriteria: Create AddStandardDialog with fields: Make, Model, Serial, STD ID, Address, Group dropdown
Group dropdown options: Calibrator, DMM, Counter, Other
When adding from detected list, pre-populate fields from scan results
Save button creates Standard record in database via SQLAlchemy session
Also creates WorkstationStandard association for current workstation
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - AddStandardDialog creates Standard and WorkstationStandard records

userStories.title: Display workstation standards table
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to see all standards assigned to my workstation in a table.
acceptanceCriteria: standards_table in WorkstationTab loads from database on tab activation
Query joins Standard with WorkstationStandard for current workstation
Displays columns: Group, Make, Model, Serial, STD ID, Address, Status
Group filter dropdown filters table by device_group
Remove button deletes WorkstationStandard association (not the Standard itself)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - showEvent triggers refresh, filters work, remove deletes association only

userStories.title: Save and load workstation configuration
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to save my workstation setup by name so I can restore it later.
acceptanceCriteria: Save As button prompts for config name and saves WorkstationConfig to database
Config stores list of standard IDs and their addresses for this workstation
Config dropdown loads available configs from database
Load button restores standards table from selected config
Validates addresses still exist in VISA before loading
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - Save/Load configs with VISA address validation

userStories.title: Add DUT form with asset number generation
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to add a new device under test with auto-generated asset number.
acceptanceCriteria: Add New DUT button in DUTTab clears form for new entry
Asset number auto-generates as Model-SerialNumber when both fields filled
Manual override checkbox allows custom asset number entry
Remote Capable checkbox shows/hides input method dropdown
Input method dropdown: Keyboard Entry, Remote Reading, Webcam OCR
Save button creates DUT record in database
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - Auto-generate asset number, manual override, remote capable toggle, database save

userStories.title: DUT search and autocomplete
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to search for DUTs by asset number or other fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Search input in DUTTab filters dut_table as user types
Search matches on: asset_number, make, model, serial_number
Results show in dut_table with columns: Asset, Make, Model, Serial, Last Cal, Due Date
Double-click result loads DUT details into form on right side
Query uses SQLAlchemy LIKE for partial matching
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - Search with ilike, double-click loads details, showEvent refreshes

userStories.title: DUT calibration due date tracking
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to set calibration intervals and see when DUTs are due.
acceptanceCriteria: Calibration tab in DUT details has: Interval (days), Last Cal Date, Due Date fields
Due date auto-calculates as Last Cal + Interval
due_table at top of DUTTab shows DUTs sorted by next_due_date
Filter dropdown: Overdue, Due This Week, Due This Month, All
Color coding: Red = overdue, Yellow = due within 7 days, Green = more than 7 days
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - Auto-calc due date, due_table with filter and color coding

userStories.title: Command bank CRUD operations
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to create and edit command sets for device models.
acceptanceCriteria: Create CommandBankDialog accessible from Standards tab or Procedures menu
Form fields: Make, Model, Device Type dropdown
Commands section with editable rows: Command Name, SCPI String
Pre-populate with common commands: *IDN?, *RST, OPER, STBY, etc.
Save stores CommandBank record with commands as JSON
List view shows all command banks, filterable by make/model
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - Full CommandBankDialog with CRUD, defaults, and filtering

userStories.title: Auto-detect missing command bank warning
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to be warned when a standard has no command bank.
acceptanceCriteria: When adding standard to workstation, check if CommandBank exists for make/model
If not found, show warning icon in standards_table Status column
Tooltip on warning: 'No command bank for [Make Model]'
Right-click context menu has 'Create Command Bank...' option
Opens CommandBankDialog pre-filled with make/model from selected standard
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - Warning icon, tooltip, context menu with Create Command Bank option

userStories.title: Create new procedure
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to create a new calibration procedure.
acceptanceCriteria: New Procedure button opens dialog with: Name, Description, Target Make, Target Model
Save creates Procedure record in database
New procedure appears in procedure_list table
Selecting procedure loads it into the builder view
name_input, target_make_input, target_model_input populate from selected procedure
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - New/Save procedure, list refresh, load into builder

userStories.title: Add test sections to procedure
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to add named sections to organize test points.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Section button creates new TestSection in database linked to current procedure
Section appears as top-level item in structure_tree QTreeWidget
Section name is editable inline
Sections ordered by 'order' field, drag-drop reordering updates order values
Delete section removes TestSection and all child TestPoints
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - Add Section creates TestSection, inline editing, move up/down, Remove button with cascade delete

userStories.title: Add test points to sections
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to add test points within sections.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Test Point button creates TestPoint under selected section
Test point appears as child item in structure_tree under its section
Selecting test point loads details into right panel form
Form fields: Test Type, Nominal, Unit, Frequency, Tolerance, Tolerance Type
Save updates TestPoint record in database
Tree displays: test point name, nominal value, tolerance
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - Add Test Point, selection loads form, Save Test Point button persists changes

userStories.title: Configure test point commands
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to set source and measure commands for test points.
acceptanceCriteria: Test point form has command fields: Source Command, Operate Command, Measure Command
Command fields support placeholder syntax: {value}, {unit}, {frequency}
Dropdown to select from CommandBank templates if make/model matches
Commands saved to TestPoint.source_command, operate_command, measure_command
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - Command template dropdown, placeholder help text, auto-populate from CommandBank

userStories.title: Excel import wizard for procedures
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to import test points from an Excel file.
acceptanceCriteria: Import from Excel button opens file dialog for .xlsx/.xls files
Wizard step 1: Select sheet from workbook
Wizard step 2: Map columns to fields (Nominal, Unit, Tolerance, Section, etc.)
Wizard step 3: Preview imported rows before confirming
Import creates TestSections and TestPoints from mapped data
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - ExcelImportDialog with 3-step wizard, creates sections and test points

userStories.title: Assign procedure to DUT
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to assign a default procedure to a DUT.
acceptanceCriteria: procedure_combo in DUT Calibration tab loads all Procedures from database
Filter procedures by target_make/target_model matching DUT if available
Selection saves Procedure ID to DUT.default_procedure_id
When loading DUT in execution tab, auto-select assigned procedure
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - _load_procedures() groups matching vs other, saves default_procedure_id

userStories.title: Start calibration session
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to start a calibration session for a DUT.
acceptanceCriteria: ExecutionTab: dut_combo loads DUTs from database with autocomplete
workorder_input is required before starting
procedure_combo loads procedures, auto-selects if DUT has default
Start Session button creates CalibrationSession record in database
Session stores: dut_id, procedure_id, work_order, technician, started_at
UI locks session fields and enables test controls
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - showEvent loads DUTs/procedures, CalibrationSession created on start

userStories.title: Load test points into execution view
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to see all test points when a session starts.
acceptanceCriteria: On session start, load TestPoints via Procedure -> TestSections -> TestPoints
Populate testpoints_table with columns: #, Section/Test, Nominal, Measured, Status
Set progress_bar maximum to total test point count
Select first test point and display in nominal_display
Update section_label, testpoint_label, tolerance_label from selected point
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - _load_test_points() loads from procedure, _update_current_display() shows details

userStories.title: Execute test point - keyboard entry
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to enter DUT readings via keyboard.
acceptanceCriteria: When input_method_combo is 'Keyboard Entry', show reading_input and submit_btn
If calibrator standard assigned, send source_command via VISAManager.write()
Send operate_command to enable output
status_display shows 'Sourcing [value]...'
User enters reading in reading_input, presses Enter or Submit
Calculate pass/fail by comparing to tolerance
Create TestResult record with measured_value, status, input_method
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - _process_reading calculates pass/fail, _save_test_result creates TestResult

userStories.title: Pass/fail tolerance calculation
userStories.description: As a technician, I want readings compared to tolerance automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: Calculate deviation = measured - nominal
For percent tolerance: pass if abs(deviation/nominal)*100 <= tolerance_value
For absolute tolerance: pass if abs(deviation) <= tolerance_value
Update testpoints_table status column: green 'Pass' or red 'Fail'
Update pass_label and fail_label counts
Advance progress_bar value by 1
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - tolerance calculation for percent, absolute, and ppm types

userStories.title: Handle failed test point dialog
userStories.description: As a technician, I want options when a test point fails.
acceptanceCriteria: On fail, show QMessageBox with Nominal, Measured, Deviation, Tolerance
Three buttons: Continue (proceed to next), Redo (repeat this point), Stop (halt session)
Log technician choice in TestResult.redo_reason or session notes
Continue: advance to next test point
Redo: re-execute current test point, link to previous result
Stop: call pause/stop handler
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - _show_fail_dialog with Retry/Ignore/Abort options

userStories.title: Advance to next test point
userStories.description: As a technician, I want the system to move to the next test point after each reading.
acceptanceCriteria: After recording result, select next row in testpoints_table
Update nominal_display with new test point's value
Update section_label, testpoint_label, tolerance_label
If wiring diagram exists for section, update wiring_label with image
If last test point, show 'Session Complete' message and enable report generation
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - _advance_to_next, _session_complete with overall result calculation

userStories.title: Pause and resume session
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to pause testing and resume later.
acceptanceCriteria: Pause button sends standby command to calibrator if connected
Button text changes to 'Resume', status shows 'Session Paused'
Resume sends operate command and continues from current test point
Session status in database updated to 'paused' or 'in_progress'
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - _pause_session/_resume_session update database status

userStories.title: Stop session and save partial results
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to stop a session and save what's done.
acceptanceCriteria: Stop button shows confirmation dialog
On confirm, send standby to calibrator
Update CalibrationSession.status to 'aborted'
All TestResults already saved (saved immediately per reading)
Re-enable session setup fields
Aborted sessions appear in history and can be viewed
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - _on_stop marks session as aborted, resets UI

userStories.title: Redo any test point
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to redo a completed test point.
acceptanceCriteria: Double-click or Redo button on any row in testpoints_table
Navigate to that test point (update displays)
Execute test point again
New TestResult links to previous via previous_result_id, is_redo=True
Table shows latest result, original preserved in history
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - _on_redo clears result and re-enables entry

userStories.title: Execute test point - remote reading
userStories.description: As a technician, I want automatic readings from remote-capable DUTs.
acceptanceCriteria: When input_method is 'Remote Reading', show get_reading_btn instead of reading_input
Click Get Remote: send source_command, operate_command to calibrator
Send measure_command to DUT via VISAManager.query()
Parse numeric response and display in reading_input
Auto-submit reading for pass/fail calculation
Handle query timeout with error message
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - _on_get_remote_reading with VISAManager integration

userStories.title: Webcam capture for OCR
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to capture DUT display via webcam.
acceptanceCriteria: When input_method is 'Webcam OCR', show capture_btn
Click Capture opens WebcamCaptureDialog with live preview
Dialog uses WebcamCapture class from ocr/webcam.py
User can draw ROI rectangle on preview to select display area
Capture button grabs frame and crops to ROI
Dialog returns captured image for OCR processing
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - _on_capture_ocr with live preview dialog and capture

userStories.title: OCR reading extraction
userStories.description: As a technician, I want OCR to extract numeric readings from captured images.
acceptanceCriteria: After capture, pass image to OCRReader or SevenSegmentReader based on DUT.ocr_mode
Display extracted text in reading_input for confirmation
User can edit/correct before submitting
Submit button processes reading same as keyboard entry
Handle OCR failure with message 'Could not read display'
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - _process_ocr_image with OCRReader/SevenSegmentReader

userStories.title: Session history and search
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to search past calibration sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: ReportsTab search fields: Asset Number, Work Order, Date Range
Search button queries CalibrationSession with filters
Results in sessions_table: Date, Asset, Work Order, Technician, Result
Color code Result column: green Pass, red Fail
Selecting session loads details and test results
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - _on_search with filters, color coding, session selection

userStories.title: View session test results
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to see all test results for a session.
acceptanceCriteria: When session selected, query TestResult joined with TestPoint
Populate results_table: Test Point, Nominal, Measured, Deviation, Status
Update detail labels: asset, DUT info, work order, date, technician, result
Calculate and display overall pass/fail based on individual results
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - _load_session_details and _load_test_results

userStories.title: Generate PDF report
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to generate a PDF calibration report.
acceptanceCriteria: Generate PDF button in ReportsTab requires session selected
Opens QFileDialog to choose save location
Calls PDFReportGenerator.generate() with session data and test results
PDF includes: header, session info table, test results table, summary, signature lines
Show success message with file path
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - _generate_pdf_report with reportlab

userStories.title: Export results to Excel
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to export calibration results to Excel.
acceptanceCriteria: Export to Excel button requires session selected
Opens QFileDialog for save location
Calls ExcelExporter.export() with session data and test results
If TestPoints have excel_cell mappings, use template export mode
Otherwise use standard export with header and data table
Show success message with file path
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - _export_to_excel with openpyxl

userStories.title: DUT calibration history
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to see all past calibrations for a specific DUT.
acceptanceCriteria: History tab in DUT details shows calibrations for selected DUT
Query CalibrationSession where dut_id matches
Display in history_table: Date, Work Order, Technician, Result
Double-click opens session in Reports tab for full details
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - _load_calibration_history populates history_table

userStories.title: Update DUT after calibration
userStories.description: As a technician, I want DUT records updated after successful calibration.
acceptanceCriteria: On session completion with overall Pass, update DUT.last_calibration_date
Auto-calculate DUT.next_due_date = last_cal + calibration_interval_days
Refresh due date displays in DUTTab
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented - _complete_session updates DUT dates on Pass

userStories.title: User preferences dialog
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to set my preferences.
acceptanceCriteria: Preferences dialog from menu with tabs: General, Webcam, Display
General: Technician Name, Technician ID, Default Input Method
Webcam: Device selection dropdown (from WebcamCapture.list_cameras())
Save updates Settings via reload_settings()
Preferences saved to ~/.calsystem/config.json

userStories.title: Application logging and log viewer
userStories.description: As an administrator, I want to view application logs.
acceptanceCriteria: Log viewer dialog accessible from Help > View Logs
Reads log files from ~/.calsystem/logs/
QTextEdit displays log contents with scroll to bottom
Refresh button reloads current log file
Log level dropdown filters displayed entries

userStories.title: Add wiring diagrams to procedures
userStories.description: As a technician, I want to add wiring diagram images to procedures.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Wiring Diagram button in ProceduresTab opens file dialog for images
Creates WiringDiagram record linked to procedure and optional section
Stores image as binary in database or saves to resources/images with path reference
Thumbnails shown in procedure builder
